You cannot go there. Pick a green tile.
You can start the night once this guide finishes.
Open the dragon window to check your slime stock.
It shows what you hold now and what settles tomorrow morning.
When an explanation ends, press [Next] to continue.
At night, monsters pour from the portals to the castle. If the castle falls it is over. Block their path by day.
Press ESC, or the BUILD MODE button again, to close the build panel.
Click the tower you just built.
Press +1 ASSIGN to staff this tower with one worker.
The closer to full staff, the higher the operation rate. A higher operation rate makes the tower fire faster. Unstaffed towers do not fire.
Press CLOSE to close the staffing panel.
Click the lab you just built.
Press +1 ASSIGN to staff the lab.
Lab workers bring research points at the end of each night. An unstaffed lab earns nothing at all.
You spend research points through the RESEARCH button. You have none today. Come back tomorrow morning.
Your people eat every day. Food comes from farms. Run out and your people leave, idling towers and workshops.
Click the farm you just built.
Press +1 ASSIGN to staff the farm.
Production scales with the workers you assign. How you split them decides each day's output.
Press CLOSE to close the staffing panel.
Yellow marks your land, green is what you can claim. Red is out of reach. Claims spread only from your land.
The figures show added population and resources.
Choose a tile to claim and click it.
DURATION is how many days the expedition needs.
Land marked MONSTER strengthens the monsters you face. Weigh what you gain against what you must hold off.
COST TO CONQUER is the price. Scroll it sideways.
Press CLAIM to send the expedition.
Land being claimed is outlined in grey. Survive that night and it is yours. Lose and it is void.
Press ESC, or the CLAIM button again, to leave claim mode.
The dragon's blessing has granted you a Life dragon egg.
Each building now shows its workers and capacity.
Left-click assigns workers and right-click recalls them. Shift-click fills capacity, while Ctrl-click moves five.
Morning has come. Every night ends with the day being settled.
Your people have eaten their food.
Click the slime farm you just built.
The terrain you build on decides which slime you get. Need a certain attribute? Claim that land first.
Assign workers. The more you put in, the more slimes it yields.
Press CLOSE to close the staffing panel.
You have many buildings now. Worker Mode lets you move population at a glance.
Press CLOSE to close the staffing panel.
Click the main castle at the centre.
This is the mother dragon's current attribute. It decides her night skills and the effect she lends.
Pick another attribute and press CHANGE ATTRIBUTE. Only once a day, so decide by what the night brings.
The portals are shaking hard. What comes tonight is not what came before.
Tonight they come from three sides, with a boss behind. You cannot hold this with the strength you have.
The castle has fallen. Where the fires died down, nothing remains.
Then a vast shadow settles over the ruins. The dragon of time.
""This was not a night that had to come yet.""
""Go back. Build it differently this time.""
Build a farm to secure food
Change the mother dragon's attribute at the main castle
Check the objective list on the right. These are today's suggestions - you can start the night without finishing them.
The red line is the path monsters will take tonight. Build your towers along it.
Receive a dragon egg and check it
Slimes are baby dragon food. Once yours hatches, it eats slimes of its own attribute every day.
Fill it to capacity and you'll have 10 points by tomorrow - enough for one research.
Quit the tutorial and start the main game? Your progress here will not be saved.
""Seal all four portals, or fell the boss of the final cycle. If the castle falls, it ends there.""
